records.issue_text: app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:22 — The unbounded client-controlled `limit` can serialize an entire large group in one request.
records.rationale: The diff shows in groups_controller.rb line 22: `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` - the limit is directly taken from client params with no upper bound validation. A malicious client could pass limit=999999 to serialize an entire large group in one request, causing performance issues or denial of service. This is a real security/performance defect introduced by this code.

records.issue_text: app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:71 — Adding a large username list performs one user lookup per entry instead of a set-based lookup.
records.rationale: The diff shows in add_members method (lines 71-82) that usernames.split(',').each iterates and calls User.find_by_username for each username individually. This is a valid performance concern - with a large list, this creates N database queries instead of a single query like User.where(username: usernames.split(',')).
